title: Research
text: My research brings together political theory, data science and statistical methods, with interests spanning computational international relations, political theory, predictive modelling and machine learning. Right now I’m part of the Data Impact Lab.

title: Research
text:
Projects



Lead Author, Data Impact Lab

Psychometric Measurement in Large Language Models
Supervised by Dr Jie Kang and Dr Kangning Du


Can an AI change its mind?
Ask it the same question twice and the answer can shift. Why?
Ask in another language. Does the answer change?
Does it take sides? And if it leans left or right, is it good at hiding it?


I study these questions by giving large language models the same political psychology scales used with people, and testing whether the measurements hold up: what it means for a model to “hold” an attitude, and how far tools built for people can be trusted when they are applied to AI.


Accepted Abstract, 12th Charles Perkins Centre EMCR Symposium
Submitted Manuscript, collection “Large Language Models in Psychological Science”, Humanities and Social Sciences Communications (Nature Portfolio)

Provided the theoretical framework, drawing on Samuel Moyn’s critique of human rights and Elizabeth Anderson’s Private Government.

title: Biography
text:
Delphine PA Dang is a Vietnamese artist, musician and researcher based in Sydney. Her research-led artistic practice draws on data science and international relations, with particular interests in political theory, political thought and computational international relations. Working across sound, performance and moving image, she brings creative experimentation and academic inquiry into dialogue.
Her practice encompasses acting, songwriting and singing, alongside collaborative roles as a producer, assistant director and editor. She trained in opera for seven years, beginning her formal vocal training after receiving the Golden Buzzer on Vietnam’s Got Talent. She also plays bass and has a background in ballet and theatre. These disciplines shape her approach to composition, presence and narrative across her artistic work.
